text: Thursday evening, the short walk across the moor to the hollow
why: Holmes says it is Thursday morning, and the group reached Tavistock 'evening' and then walked out to the hollow before the light failed, so the walk falls on Thursday evening.

text: Thursday evening, at the hollow where the body was found
why: The hollow is where Straker's body was found (¶35), and the group reaches it at the end of the Thursday evening walk (¶93).
